items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I'd book John, I never did manage him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was looking at that, huh? Yeah, Johnny Adams. That is John.

It's a good picture. I'd book John, I never did manage him. I'd book him and he had his first record on him, but some way he'd take and he couldn't understand, you know, and I'd just drop him. Everybody was talking to him, you know, and I guess he'd work a million dollars a night, so I'd just quit doing that. But now, him and our friends, I get no jobs for him. He's playing Pensacola Saturday night coming. Oh, is he? Yeah.
Yeah, he's still working pretty well.
